_meta.purpose: Scoring dimensions that separate fundability, readiness, eligibility, fit, and confidence.

records.label: Revenue Strength
records.formula: 0 if no revenue; 4 if $3k+; 8 if $8.5k+; 11 if $15k+; 13 if $20k+; 15 if $100k+; subtract 2-5 for inconsistent deposits.
records.notes: Revenue thresholds mirror recurring product patterns in verified products.

records.label: Time in Business
records.formula: 0 for not launched; 3 for 0-3 months; 5 for 4-5 months; 7 for 6-11 months; 10 for 12-23 months; 12 for 24+ months.
records.notes: Do not treat short TIB as an auto-decline; route to startup or revenue-first paths when other signals support it.

records.label: Credit Readiness
records.formula: 1 below 500; 4 for 500-579; 7 for 580-599; 10 for 600-659; 12 for 660-679; 14 for 680-699; 15 for 700+; subtract for recent derogatory events.
records.notes: Credit matters more for SBA, LOC, startup stacking, unsecured finance, and personal products.

records.label: Bankability
records.formula: 0 no bank account; 4 low/inconsistent deposits; 8 consistent deposits; 12 strong clean deposits; cap at 5 if recent NSFs are present.
records.notes: Bank data is the practical underwriting center for fast capital.

records.label: Documentation Readiness
records.formula: 2 minimal docs; 5 bank statements ready; 7 platform/API or asset docs ready; 10 full financials/tax returns/debt schedule ready.
records.notes: Readiness is not the same as eligibility; strong borrowers can still be operationally unready.

records.label: Entity Readiness
records.formula: 1 no formal business; 4 sole prop; 5 entity/no bank; 7 entity+bank; 8 entity+bank+EIN+clean records.
records.notes: Sole proprietors can be eligible for some paths, but entity readiness improves operational quality.

records.label: Use-Case Fit
records.formula: Score product/family match to funding purpose: 10 direct match; 7 adjacent; 4 unclear; 0 incompatible.
records.notes: Use case should route first to family, then to products.

records.label: Risk-Adjusted Strength
records.formula: Start at 12; subtract critical 12, high 6-9, medium 3-5, low 1-2; cannot drop below 0.
records.notes: Risk flags are severity-weighted, not linear fluff tokens.

records.label: Data Confidence
records.formula: Start at 100; subtract 5 per missing critical input; 10-20 for contradictory answers; 15 for unverifiable claims; product confidence modifies final match score.
records.notes: Low confidence does not equal bad borrower; it means do not over-rank recommendations.

records.label: Operational Readiness
records.formula: documentation*0.35 + entity*0.20 + bankability*0.30 + confidence*0.15 normalized to 100.
records.notes: This tells whether the borrower can survive the underwriting process.

records.label: Fundability
records.formula: revenue*0.25 + credit*0.22 + TIB*0.18 + bankability*0.20 + risk_adjusted*0.15 normalized to 100.
records.notes: This estimates access to capital, separate from documentation readiness.

records.label: Eligibility
records.formula: For each product: credit pass, revenue pass, TIB pass, geography pass, industry pass, disqualifier pass. Hard fail if any non-waivable required rule fails.
records.notes: Eligibility is product-specific and must use product rules before provider/family defaults.

records.label: Fit
records.formula: Weighted qualitative compatibility after eligibility. Fit can be high even if readiness needs work, but recommendations should show caveats.
records.notes: Fit answers whether this is the right path, not merely possible.
